prompt: Create an original overworld NPC reference sheet for five different anthropomorphic cyberpunk animals for a cozy Game Boy game called Dialtone. The sheet must be designed for classic Pokemon handheld readability. Show five clearly separated full-body overworld characters on a plain neutral background. Mina is a fennec fox clerk with very large triangular ears and headphones. Rook is a raven repair tech with a distinct beak silhouette and utility vest. Soma is a raccoon ramen cook with clear raccoon eye mask and striped tail, plus a simple apron. Iona is a rabbit rooftop DJ with unmistakably long upright ears and layered streetwear. Pix is a cat street resident with cat ears, hood, messenger bag, and curled tail. Make every silhouette distinct and easy to trace into a 16x16 Game Boy sprite. No text, no labels, no overlap, no extra props cluttering the forms.
style: late Game Boy and Game Boy Color overworld sprite reference sheet, original cyberpunk neighborhood cast, simple Pokemon-style silhouette readability
composition: single clean lineup sheet with five separated characters, lots of spacing, centered, plain background, tracing-friendly
palette: mostly grayscale with tiny teal and magenta accent touches only where helpful
constraints: species must be visually obvious at a glance, must survive simplification into 16x16 sprites, no perspective tilt, no watermark, no busy background
negative: realism, painterly art, splash illustration, giant props, clutter, labels, extra characters, species ambiguity, noisy textures
